name: Comcast Corporation
tagline: Leading global media and technology company
hero_kpi_rationale: Le revenu des plates-formes de connectivité reflète la performance des services de base (broadband, wireless, video et voix) qui constituent le cœur du modèle économique de Comcast et génèrent la majorité des flux de trésorerie.

kpis.explanation: Revenue from residential broadband services delivered over HFC and fiber networks
kpis.signal: Core revenue stream from Connectivity Platforms segment
kpis.description: Le revenu des services de broadband résidentiel provient de la fourniture de connectivité Internet haut débit aux clients résidentiels aux États-Unis, au Royaume-Uni et en Italie.
kpis._validation: KPI halluciné: valeur et historique non disponibles dans le 10-K fourni; unité corrigée de 'Mds $' à '$ M'; is_generic changé de true à false; historique vide confirmé

kpis.explanation: Revenue from wireless mobile services offered to residential and business customers
kpis.signal: Emerging growth segment within Connectivity Platforms
kpis.description: Le revenu des services sans fil provient de l'offre de services de téléphonie mobile et de données sans fil aux clients résidentiels et commerciaux utilisant le réseau de Verizon en tant que MVNO.
kpis._validation: KPI halluciné: valeur et historique non disponibles dans le 10-K fourni; unité corrigée de 'Mds $' à '$ M'; is_generic changé de true à false; historique vide confirmé

stories_kpis.Explanation: Spin-off of Versant Media Group as an independent publicly traded company completed January 2, 2026
stories_kpis.Signal: Major strategic restructuring of media portfolio
stories_kpis.Description: La séparation de Versant Media Group en tant que société indépendante cotée en bourse a été complétée le 2 janvier 2026. Versant comprend les réseaux de télévision câblée historiques (MS NOW, CNBC, USA Network, Golf Channel, E!, SYFY, Oxygen) et les plates-formes numériques complémentaires (GolfNow, Fandango, Rotten Tomatoes, SportsEngine).
stories_kpis._validation: Value corrigé de '2026' (année) à '2026-01-02' (date exacte du 10-K); Unit corrigé de 'Année' à 'Date'; Is_wow changé de false à true (événement majeur complété); Story_category corrigé de 'Innovation' à 'Strategic Restructuring'; Type amélioré; Description enrichie avec détails du 10-K

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mentions of artificial intelligence, machine learning, or similar technologies in the provided 10-K excerpts. AI positioning remains undefined for Comcast as of the latest filing.

risks.title: Network Infrastructure Dependency
risks.score_rationale: Comcast operates hybrid fiber-optic and coaxial (HFC) networks and depends on third-party telecommunications providers internationally; network quality and availability are critical to service delivery (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: The company is exposed to risks related to network availability, capacity constraints, and obsolescence as technology evolves

risks.title: Competitive Intensity
risks.score_rationale: Telecommunications and media distribution markets are highly competitive with established players and emerging digital platforms (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Intense competition in broadband, wireless, video, and streaming segments threatens market share and pricing power

risks.title: Regulatory and Compliance
risks.score_rationale: Comcast operates under extensive telecommunications, media, and consumer protection regulations that vary by jurisdiction (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Evolving regulations on net neutrality, content, privacy, and international operations may impact business flexibility and profitability

risks.title: Cybersecurity and Data Protection
risks.score_rationale: As a connectivity and media company, Comcast manages significant customer data, network infrastructure and intellectual property exposed to sophisticated cyber threats (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Increased cyber threats including ransomware, data breaches, and DDoS attacks pose risks to customer trust, regulatory compliance, and operational continuity

risks.title: Technology Obsolescence
risks.score_rationale: Rapid technology evolution requires continuous capital investment in network upgrades and platform modernization (e.g., fiber deployment, cloud-based services) (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Failure to invest adequately in emerging technologies could lead to competitive disadvantage and service quality deterioration

risks.title: Third-party Partnership Risks
risks.score_rationale: Comcast relies on partnerships with network providers (Verizon for wireless MVNO), content distributors, and technology vendors for service delivery (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Dependence on partner reliability, quality of service, and contractual terms creates operational and financial risks

governance.voting_structure: Brian L. Roberts holds a special class of common stock with disproportionately high voting power, enabling control despite a minority economic stake.
